title: Restricted functions have bounded gate width
statement: Let $m,n$ be nonnegative integers, let $G$ be an AND or OR gate, and let $v_i:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$ be a family indexed by $i\in\text{Fin}(m)$. Choose a coordinate set $J\subseteq\text{Fin}(n)$, an assignment of signs to the coordinates outside $J$, and an index $i\in\text{Fin}(m)$. The restriction of $v_i$ obtained by fixing those outside coordinates has width, in the normal form associated with $G$, at most the maximum decision-tree depth of the similarly restricted functions in the family.
hypotheses_covered: Choice of an AND or OR gate
Family of Boolean functions indexed by Fin(m)
Sign assignment to coordinates outside J
